patch.value: Revalidate blocked items against the live state of their GitHub blockers

Add `pm github blockers`: re-read every blocked item (plus non-terminal items whose blocked_by dependency targets an external GitHub reference), parse blocked_reason/description/comments for GitHub references (owner/repo#N, bare #N vs the item repo or --repo, full issue/PR URLs, GH-N), query their current state via batched GraphQL, and report a verdict (cleared / partially_cleared / still_blocked / unresolvable). Report-only: never auto-unblock; --comment appends one idempotent pm comment per cleared item. Exit 0 when nothing cleared, a documented non-zero code when something cleared so CI and the scheduled sync can alert.

value.text: CodeRabbit round 3 (three small findings on the blockers PR): (1) runBlockers docstring/registration comment misstate the exit-1 contract as 'every reference failed'; code returns exit 1 when any reference state query errors or any requested comment fails, taking precedence over 4. (2) test/blockers.test.ts imports decodeToonItemContent from a private pm-cli dist path at top level; no public SDK decoder exists and the repo lint policy bans inline import(), so plan to decode TOON via the public @toon-format/toon package (same pinned 4.1.1 parser pm-cli itself uses) declared as a devDependency. (3) fs.symlinkSync(..., "dir") for node_modules in the CLI test fails with EPERM on Windows without symlink privileges; use a junction on win32. Starting with the doc contract fix.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: All three CodeRabbit round-3 findings fixed: (1) runBlockers docstring and the registration comment now state exit 1 when any reference state query or requested comment fails (precedence over 4); test renamed from 'every reference state failed' to 'any reference state query fails'. Verified the existing mixed-access test already locks precedence (partially_cleared item + query error exits 1, not 4), so the corrected contract is test-covered; docs-only change, no revert proof applicable. (2) Test no longer imports pm-cli's private dist/core/item/toon-decode.js at module top level. The SDK surface exposes no decoder (checked sdk, sdk/core, sdk/testing exports) and the repo lint policy bans inline import(), so the review's suggested dynamic import would fail lint. Instead the test decodes TOON output with the public @toon-format/toon parser — the exact function and version pm-cli's own decoder delegates to — added as an exact 4.1.1 devDependency to avoid version skew. (3) The node_modules link in the CLI end-to-end test now uses a junction on win32 (real dir symlinks need privileges/Developer Mode there); Node ignores the link type on other platforms, so behaviour on POSIX is unchanged — not regress-testable off Windows, verified by the full test file passing.
